data.cultural_impact: The name Itsaf is not only significant to the Arab world, but also holds great value in various Islamic communities across the globe. It is a name representing the idea of security and refuge, which is embedded in Islamic beliefs and practices. Itsaf (or Itsafa) is a name that echoes the protection given by Allah to His believers, as mentioned in numerous verses of the Quran and Hadiths. This name holds a powerful symbolism, reminding us of the assurance of Allah's protection and safety in times of need.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Itsaf goes beyond the materialistic aspect of protection and safety. It represents the deeper concept of faith, trust, and reliance on Allah's ultimate power and wisdom. The name Itsaf is a reminder that ultimate protection and safety come from Allah, and that the believers are under His unwavering care and protection. It emphasizes the importance of seeking refuge in Allah, as mentioned in various verses of the Quran like "And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], about Me, then (answer) I am indeed near. I respond to the invocations of the supplicant when he calls on Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be rightly guided." (Al-Baqarah: 186). The name Itsaf, therefore, is a constant reminder of the spiritual bond between the believer and Allah, emphasizing the importance of trusting in Allah's protection and ultimate safety.

This battle marked the final defeat of the Meccan army and consolidated Muslim rule over the Arabian Peninsula.
